content.intro: This lesson introduces closures and lexical scoping as part of advanced python language features. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: A good function has a clear contract: inputs, output, side effects, and failure behavior. Keep one responsibility in each function and test important edge cases.
